reading: ちょうきょりみさいる

definitions.explanation: A missile designed to reach distant targets, often thousands of kilometers away. Contrasts with short- and medium-range missiles.

examples.japanese: {長距離|ちょうきょり}ミサイルを{保有|ほゆう}する。
{長距離|ちょうきょり}ミサイルは{他国|たこく}まで{届|とど}く。
examples.english: Long-range missiles can reach other countries.

examples.japanese: {長距離|ちょうきょり}ミサイルの{開発|かいはつ}は、{周辺国|しゅうへんこく}の{強|つよ}い{懸念|けねん}を{招|まね}いた。
examples.english: The development of long-range missiles drew strong concern from neighboring countries.

notes:
A compound of {長距離|ちょうきょり} (long distance) and ミサイル (missile). One of the standard range categories in news coverage of defense and missile tests; the longest-range types can cross continents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長距離|ちょうきょり}ミサイルを{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop long-range missiles
- {長距離|ちょうきょり}{弾道|だんどう}ミサイル: a long-range ballistic missile
- {長距離|ちょうきょり}ミサイルの{脅威|きょうい}: the threat of long-range missiles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {短距離|たんきょり}ミサイル: short-range missile — strikes only nearby targets
- {大陸間|たいりくかん}{弾道|だんどう}ミサイル: intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) — the longest-range class
